query:
UPDATE sequenceTemplates
SET delayHours = 96
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND touchKey = 'day_3_spots_filling';

UPDATE sequenceTemplates
SET delayHours = 168
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND touchKey = 'day_6_last_call';

SELECT touchKey, delayHours FROM sequenceTemplates
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND touchKey IN ('day_3_spots_filling', 'day_6_last_call');
